03:08 < sinfonian> well I am going to try out media player 9.. I hope its worth this wait
03:08 < PsycoXul> MouseLRN compiled SDL for it...

03:09 < PsycoXul> sometimes audio anyway
03:10 < PsycoXul> i wonder if gimp'll run it
03:10 < PsycoXul> i guess if you have a big storage enough storage card to have plenty of swap space, you could run anything that doesn't need floating point eh? heh
03:11 < sinfonian> it wont use swap space..
03:11 < PsycoXul> and probably stuff with floating point to some degree, i would imagine, if we get FP emu anyway
03:11 < PsycoXul> sinfonian: why not?
03:11 < sinfonian> and floating point will be emulated in the kernel
03:11 < PsycoXul> being able to would be a good thing i think
03:12 < sinfonian> swap space isnt practical with a cf card... too slow and a cf card has a limited lifespan and cant handle the read and writes for swap spac
03:12 < PsycoXul> really?
03:12 < PsycoXul> CF cards are slower than HD's?
03:13 < PsycoXul> and how's it's lifespan and r/w handling so limited?
03:13 < sinfonian> well some are slower
03:14 < sinfonian> and the mean failure rate is 100,000 read write cycles
03:14 < sinfonian> so for every 1,000 write cycles there is a 1% chance of faliure in that cell
03:15 < PsycoXul> for as much as they cost for so little space, and their being so unpractical as mass storage... seems kinda odd, all they're good for is writing stuff, reading it, deleting it, over and over... seems like a hell of a ripoff if they're not even really good at that heh
03:15 < PsycoXul> heh
03:15 < sinfonian> and if one cell goes bad a whole chunk will go bad.. like 512k or so
03:15 < PsycoXul> damn
03:15 < sinfonian> well they are fine for cammeras and PDA storage.. just not intense read and write stuff
03:16 < PsycoXul> microdrives any better? or they just too power hungry?
03:16 < sinfonian> it isnt like ram really  more like a floppy with out the mechanics
03:16 < sinfonian> I think they are way worse
03:16 < sinfonian> they are too delicate
03:16 < sinfonian> break easy
03:16 < PsycoXul> heh
03:17 < PsycoXul> well damnit
03:17 < PsycoXul> heh
03:18 < sinfonian> lots of problems with them getting bumped around and the head scratching the disks
03:18 < PsycoXul> yeah i can imagine
